title: Free generators of S3 quasi-invariants in characteristic three
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: Characteristic three has nonsplit indecomposable modules and exceptional Ren–Xu counterexamples absent from the characteristic-two construction. The author builds minimal generators with extension-type control and proves the six-generator freeness and exhaustion; the earlier counterexample induction and indecomposable analyses remain part of the core.
author: Frank Wang; Eric Yee
